map.消防演练记录与消防设施检查工具，支持消防演练评估（10项指标）和消防设施日常检查: Fire drill records and fire facility inspection tool supporting fire drill assessment (10 indicators) and routine fire facility inspection (10 check items), automatically generating assessment reports and rectification lists.
map.消防演练评估（含疏散用时分析）: Fire drill assessment (including evacuation time analysis)
map.不合格项自动整改清单: Automatic rectification list for failed items
map.演练得分 = 各检查项评分（每项 1–5 分）累加；满分 = 检查项数 × 5；: Drill score = sum of all checklist item scores (1-5 points each); maximum = item count × 5; score rate = score ÷ maximum × 100%. Grades: >=90% excellent, >=75% good, >=60% acceptable, otherwise non-conforming; items scoring <=2 are automatically listed as issues and improvements. Evacuation time grading: <=120 s excellent, <=300 s acceptable, <=600 s long, >600 s non-conforming
